creator: Dr. Debasis Pahi
title: Great CFOs Challenge AI Outputs — Judgment in the Age of Agentic Finance
tagline: Preparing Business Students for the AI-Powered Economy
summary: Agentic AI is moving from pilot to production in finance functions. Real cases from HPE, Alphabet, Trintech, BeSmartee and Philips India illustrate the shift. CFOs must expand from financial stewardship to governing the intelligence layer while keeping human judgment as the final decision authority. Key data: 60% of finance leaders expect substantially higher AI costs through 2027; more than half already lead AI capital allocation.
philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
sources: CFO Dive coverage of HPE, Alphabet, Trintech, BeSmartee, Deloitte surveys (2026)
BW CFO World interview with Philips India CFO Dev Tripathy
Forbes on fractional CFOs and cfo.ai
